tagline: What self-hosting actually costs, per tool, per team size.
description: Transparent cost comparisons between commercial SaaS and their self-hosted open-source alternatives. Every number is computed from a published sizing model and dated price sources.
author: SelfHostCost

fx.note: Vendors that served a pricing page in euros are converted to US dollars at this single dated rate, which is published on the methodology page so any figure can be reproduced.
fx.source_name: Frankfurter, European Central Bank reference rates

tco_model.notes: Labour is the dominant hidden cost of self-hosting and is included by default. Readers can zero it out on any page; the published figures always state whether labour is included.
